'''Shella Rinou''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] who worked alongside the [[Herglic/Legends|Herglic]] [[Kelric (Herglic)|Kelric]]. Shella was the youngest daughter of [[Malcolm Dallory]], the captain of a fleet of smuggling [[Starship/Legends|vessels]]. In around [[1 BBY/Legends|1.5 BBY]] she left home to learn the business from the ground up, accompanied by Kelric. 

Headstrong, bright, and a bit too sure of herself, Shella was kept in place (and in one piece) by Kelric, at the behest of Malcolm.

Shella was the owner of the light [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]], the ''[[Listing Dewback]]'' with which she had made several trips to [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], owing to its stealth system. 

At some point, she journeyed to Rodia to deliver a cargo of weapons to a [[Unidentified smuggling client|client]]. On their approach to the planet in [[3 ABY/Legends|3.5 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> despite her confidence, she was shocked to find the planetary sensors had been upgraded, necessitating a backup stealth system; the anxious situation had exchanges of sarcastic remarks with Kelric.

The problems didn't end there. The ''Dewback'' had to land in the continental interior, with heavy night air. The client had vanished and the [[Unidentified Rodian in loincloth|leader]] of a local population of [[Chekkoo clan/Legends|Chekkoo]] [[Rodian/Legends|Rodians]] claimed him to have "shucumbed to the dangers of our [[Ekloska forest]]s" and would take the shipment himself for a war against the [[Chattza clan/Legends|Chattza clan]]. 

The Rodians moved in on Shella and Kelric to take the weapon shipment, however upon Kelric's command, they ran back into the ship and launched in time, as the Rodians below shooted in vain with their [[blaster/Legends|blasters]].
